subject: CAIQ assertion sampler & evidence routing for HelixBank
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@helixbank.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixbank.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - sampling and log examples for retention controls

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of HelixBank's CAIQ review we need a small sample package showing how Redwood satisfies the data retention and logging controls (CSA CCM v4):

- Short answers (assertions) for A.9 and A.10 (retention / logging)
- A small log sample for a 7-day window demonstrating access and deletion events (anonymized)
- A diagram or brief explanation of retention enforcement (auto-delete, TTLs, backups)

Can you confirm scope: we only need production infra and the Hosted API for this review (no Dedicated/Private evidence required). Target delivery is EOD Friday (2027-03-12).

Also please attach the CAIQ assertion sheet if you have an exportable draft.

Best,
Alice Turner
Senior InfoSec Manager, HelixBank
alice.turner@helixbank.com
+1 415-555-0189

--
HelixBank: Compliance intake portal https://compliance.helixbank.com/requests/2441

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@helixbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - sampling and log examples for retention controls

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Confirming scope: Hosted API only, production environment. We can provide the assertion sheet + a redacted log sample and a short retention diagram.

Planned deliverables (ETA 2027-03-12 EOD):
- CAIQ assertions (spreadsheet): one row per CAIQ question with our short answer + control owner link
- Log sample (tar.gz) with anonymized IDs and a README explaining fields
- Retention diagram (PDF) describing TTLs, backups, and deletion workflow
- Optional: a short walk-through recording (5–7 minutes) if you want a live demo

Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) For the log sample, do you need network-level logs (LB/edge) or application access logs only?
2) For retention, is HelixBank ok with a sanitized example that replaces personal identifiers with tokens?

I'll attach the draft CAIQ assertions now and Kimberly will coordinate the log extraction.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
(415) 555-0122

Attachments: caiq-assertions-draft.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - sampling and log examples for retention controls

Hi all — looping in the evidence owners and shortlist of artifacts.

Rohan, per the ask we will provide:
- Annotations for CAIQ A.9/A.10 in the attached spreadsheet (control owner + evidence pointer)
- Log sample: application access logs (api-gateway) + audit events (admin console). We will not include network packet captures unless HelixBank explicitly requests them.
- Retention diagram (PDF) showing TTLs for request logs, KV caches, and persistent backups

Artifact list (to be uploaded to Drive):
1) caiq-assertions-draft.xlsx (one sheet with short answers and owner field)
2) log-sample-202702.tar.gz (seven-day window, anonymized; README included)
3) retention-diagram.pdf

Timing: we will stage artifacts on the shared drive by 2027-03-12 15:00 PT and send a secure download link. If HelixBank needs a longer sampling window we can extend, but it will push delivery 24–48 hours.

Kimberly Park
Security Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

--
Marissa: feel free to add any legal redaction notes or doc links.

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Turner <alice.turner@helixbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - sampling and log examples for retention controls

Thanks — that scope looks good. A couple quick responses:
1) Application access logs + audit events are sufficient for our initial review. If we need network-level evidence we will request it in a follow-up.
2) Yes, sanitized/anonymized samples are fine. Please ensure deletion events are visible in the sample (e.g., delete API calls or admin removals).

Please upload the artifacts to the shared drive and reply-all with the link when ready. We will consume the artifacts and follow up with any clarifying q's by 2027-03-15.

Also: can you add a one-line assertion for RACI (who runs retention enforcement) in the CAIQ sheet? That will help our reviewers.

Best,
Raj Patel
Sr. Compliance Analyst, HelixBank
raj.patel@helixbank.com
